messages:
anika: Nightly eval alert — INT8 precision profile for 'orca-7b-v2' shows a big drop. Pass rate 82% vs baseline ~97%. Anyone else seeing this? @samir :rotating_light:

samir: Yep, CI flagged it at 03:12 run. I pulled the logs, uploading to s3://redwood-eval/nightlies/1765009876/int8-run.tar.gz

ci-bot: nightly-eval/job/1765009876 completed — failures: 18/100, baseline failures: 3/100, metric: exact_match down 14.2%

eva-ml: Quick sanity check — can we diff FP16 vs INT8 on the top 10 failing prompts? Ran compare on sample id 3427, INT8 output truncated mid-sentence for one case.

kai: Reproducing locally with seed=42, int8 profile 'auto-calib-v3'. Starting a local run now.

anika: Reminder — we rolled model config yesterday: orca-7b-v2 + quant-profile auto-calib-v3. Unsure if regression is model or runtime/kernel related.

samir: Looking at calibration stats: activation range bias shifted. Summary snippet:
```
layer,baseline_mean,current_mean
attn_3,0.12,0.24
ffn_5,-0.03,0.09
```
Mean bias moved positive in several layers — could be range estimation bug in the calibration pipeline.

eva-ml: I ran FP8 path for same commit; FP8 passes the eval set. So failure seems isolated to INT8 quantization. :thinking_face:

kai: Also checked tokenization diffs — none. But logs show occasional -inf in softmax inputs before stable norm for some sequences, e.g.:
```
WARN model/runtime: softmax input overflow -> -inf at step 42, seq 13
```

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0421 for this degradation. Severity P2.

samir: Hypothesis: runtime picked an approximate GEMM kernel for int8 small-seq workloads after the last kernel selector tweak. For FP8 path it selects the precise kernel. I forced GEMM='precise' locally and pass rate returned to ~96% on the same eval seed.

anika: Good find. Can we gate that kernel selection for INT8 until we validate? If it's the cause, we should patch runtime to avoid the approx GEMM for int8 transiently.

samir: I'll draft a runtime PR to add a config flag runtime.int8.disable_approx_gemm = true and a unit test that replays the failing seq. Linking draft: https://code/repo/pull/4321

kai: Also adding a short repro script: `scripts/repro_int8_kernel.sh` — it runs the sample set with and without the approx kernel.

anika: Operation plan: 1) Merge PR to gate kernel, 2) Canary deploy to a small subset of inference nodes, 3) run nightly eval subset, 4) roll to prod if green. For Dedicated customers, consider applying the gate only to served instances where config permits.

eva-ml: Starting canary evals now on canary cluster (canary-3). Will report pass rates in ~30m.

ci-bot: CI for PR 4321: unit tests 18 passed, 2 flaky ignored.

samir: PR is ready for review — tagging @kai @anika. Adding notes about calibration histograms and the reproduced failure case.

kai: LGTM, added a couple comments on logging and a suggestion to emit a metric when approx GEMM is selected. Merging in 5m.

ops-bot: Deploy started to canary cluster canary-3. Progress: 0/3 nodes -> 1/3 -> 3/3.

eva-ml: Canary results posted: pass rate ~95% on the sampled eval set (up from 82%). No -inf softmax occurrences in the sample runs.

anika: Thanks everyone. Plan looks good — after +1h stability we'll roll to full prod and close INC-2026-0421. Samir, please follow up with a postmortem note on the kernel selector change and add a testcase in our nightly calibration sweep to detect this class of regressions.

samir: Will do. Also adding a backfill to the calibration monitor to detect mean shifts > 0.08 per-layer.

eva-ml: Marking this thread resolved from eval perspective. I'll update the eval runbook with the repro steps.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status -> resolved.

anika: Great work — include a short blurb in release notes and flag customers who had Dedicated traffic during the window. :thumbsup:
